verdicts.matching_evidence: Section 3.3 defines `Transfer = PassRate(A₁, T₁ ∩ T₂)`, i.e. the *intersection* of the two task sets. Since T₁ and T₂ are disjoint by construction ... the intersection is empty and this quantity is undefined. However, Sections 5.3, 6.2 and 6.4 all describe transfer as pass rate on T₁ ∪ T₂ (the *union*) after Phase 1 optimization. This is almost certainly a typo (∩ → ∪), but as written the equation defines the reported metric on an empty set. Fix: change T₁ ∩ T₂ to T₁ ∪ T₂ in the 'Transfer' line of the metric block in Section 3.3.
